fusions.name: Tongue Lash
fusions.desc: A flicked lash that deals 4 damage, up to 1.6 times at maximum range, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Numbing Bite
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and stuns it for 1.2 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Toxic Skin
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, who is left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Spring
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you instantly regain 10 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.
